title: The Best UK Air Fryers For Family Of 4-6
excerpt: When it comes to air fryers for a family of 4 or more people, selecting the perfect capacity is essential, so that you don't have to cook meals in multiple batches.&n

content.html:
When it comes to air fryers for a family of 4 or more people, selecting the perfect capacity is essential, so that you don't have to cook meals in multiple batches. 

Spoiler Alert: Our Top Picks Are Listed Below!

Read on till the end to discover the detailed review of each one of them.

How To Choose An Air Fryer For A Family Of 4 Or More?

Air fryers come in many shapes, sizes, and liter capacities. Usually, for a family of 4 people, a family-sized air fryer of 3.8-5.7 liters works well. On the other hand, for a family of 5-6 people, you'll need an extra-large air fryer with a capacity of 6.6-7.6 liters. 

Ultimately, it depends on how many people you want to cook for. So we have categorised our list of top picks, keeping the size in mind so that you can check out the products worry-free!

Best Air Fryer For Family Of 4

Pro Breeze Air Fryer 5.5 L

The Pro Breeze air fryer is one of the top contenders in the air fryer market by releasing a model that outperforms other more expensive alternatives. I can't think of a better value than this one that works well for a family of 4. A great deal of consideration went into the design and creation of this item.

Key Features:

  • It comes with a digital LED Display and seven preset cooking modes.
  • This programmable air fryer features advanced super hot cyclone technology.
  • The accessories of this air fryer are dishwasher safe and have in-built advanced safety features.
  • It is an 1800 W air fryer with completely adjustable temperature and time control.

What I Like:

The first thing I like the most is the ease of use – with a few pushes of button, you can operate the device. And with usage over time, handling the air fryer becomes much easier and more convenient. 

Cleaning the air fryer is also quite simple. It includes a big, fully removable, family-size fry basket that is dishwasher-safe and simple to clean.

In terms of cooking, this device works well, too – whether you are trying to cook roasted potatoes, salmon, or bacon, you can't go wrong. Moreover, the noise of the air fryer is not too much compared to other similar brands.

What I Didn’t Like:

The basket quality could be better. Also, if you have large hands, removing the basket from the appliance may be challenging without touching the hot surface because the space between the handle and the device is relatively less. Other than that, the device is good.

Who Should Get This Air Fryer:

This air fryer is a nice option if you need to cook for a family of four on a budget without sacrificing efficiency.

Best Air Fryer For Family Of 5

COSORI Air Fryer 5.5 L

Most air fryers have fewer than 11 options for cooking. But this Cosori air fryer can handle the responsibilities of a multi-cooker. It is perfect for serving 3-5 people. 

With the 5.5-liter capacity, the air fryer offers great value for its price because of its dishwasher-safe fryer pans and ability to accommodate a full chicken.

Key Features:

  • This 5.5 L air fryer features about 13 one-touch functions, allowing beginners to cook food without worry. 
  • This air fryer includes a recipe booklet to help you with your next meal.
  •  It is available in three colours: red, black, and white, and the air fryer is dishwasher safe.
  • The basket size is enough to cook two steaks, 15 chicken wings, or 2.25 kg of chicken in one go.
  • The basket is square-shaped, unlike most other traditional baskets of other air fryer brands, thus offering a bit more room.

What I Like:

The first thing I like the most about this air fryer is its sleek design with different colour options. The square basket is spacious enough to hold a fair amount of food without taking up too much counter space, and it is well-designed.

Another thing I like the most about this air fryer is that it is very simple to clean. The basket is PFOA-free and nonstick; you can easily clean it with dish soap and water.

Operating the air fryer is not a hassle either. It offers around 11 multifunctional preset options. And you can cook almost anything with this air fryer.

What I Didn’t Like:

The buttons feel relatively low quality. Also, you may not enjoy how the pre-heating works because less automation is present, and you must manually press the controls after regular intervals to let it work. But overall, not a big issue.

Who Should Get This Air Fryer:

This is the right pick for you if you are looking for a decent air fryer that looks cool on your countertop and is easy to operate and clean.

>> Check the latest price here (on Amazon UK)

Best Air Fryer For Family Of 6

Uten Air Fryer 6.5 L

Want to serve 6-8 people? Then look no further than the Uten Air fryer. It is a large-capacity air fryer with an eight-in-one touchscreen menu.

Key Features:

  • It is made of stainless steel and features over-heat protection and auto-off sensors.
  • It uses high-speed air circulation technology to ensure the food is deliciously fried.
  • The LED screen allows you to operate the device easily and has a temperature range of 100-200°C.
  • This 1800W air fryer weighs around 7 kg and enables you to cook chicken, shrimp, cake, and more.

What I Like:

The best thing I like about this air fryer is its large basket that provides you with enough space to cook meals for more people. Also, the basket is quite simple to clean because all the parts come out easily.

The air fryer is made of stainless steel material, so you can expect good durability, unlike the air fryers made with mainly plastic materials.

Moreover, the air fryer unit looks nice overall and can be a nice addition to your kitchen countertop.

What I Didn’t Like:

The only thing I didn't like: The touch control buttons and overall operation. Honestly, buttons can be confusing if you are using it for the first time. There's a little learning curve involved. 

That said, with time, it should become easier as you explore the controls. Rest everything about the air fryer is good.

Who Should Get This Air Fryer:

If you want an air fryer for six or more people that has the perfect size, works well, and is simple to clean, this air fryer is for you.
